rewrites.comment: Proxy the API through this origin instead of calling Render directly. The client uses a relative /api base URL, so this keeps requests same-origin: no CORS preflight, no third-party-cookie problems, and the backend URL never ships to the browser. Replace the host with your own Render service before deploying.
SPA fallback — React Router owns every other path. Without this, a hard refresh on /patients/123 is a 404 from Vercel.

headers.comment: The service worker must never be cached, or users are pinned to a stale app shell after a deploy.
